items.title: Island Mayor Pleads With Japan Airlines Mileage Runners After Locals Can’t Book Flights
items.why: Promo-driven mileage running can crowd out local demand and draw backlash that shapes how future loyalty promotions are designed.
items.summary_ai: A Japan Airlines double status points promotion drew mileage runners to Okinawa's remote islands, filling seats locals needed.
items.take: Promo-driven mileage running can crowd out local demand and draw backlash that shapes how future loyalty promotions are designed.
data_points: Up to 12 flights booked per day
